# Third-party source intake and checkout plan

The executable manifest is third_party/manifest/zerovm.xml. Run bash third_party/scripts/sync_sources.sh to download selected source projects into third_party/aosp/.

| Upstream | Purpose | Checkout / pin policy |
|---|---|---|
| AOSP system/core | libsparse, liblp, fs_mgr, image primitives | android-latest-release; exact SHA generated by source lock |
| AOSP libavb | AVB/VBMeta parsing and verification | android-latest-release; exact SHA generated by source lock |
| AOSP libbase/logging/libfmq/libvintf | Native base, diagnostics, IPC, VINTF | android-latest-release; exact SHA generated by source lock |
| AOSP SELinux / system sepolicy | Guest policy and security reference | android-latest-release; exact SHA generated by source lock |
| AOSP AVF | Platform VM API/service reference | android-latest-release; authorization remains separately gated |
| Android Common Kernel | Guest ARM64 Kernel baseline | android16-6.12-2025-12; match to Guest Profile |
| crosvm | VMM and VirtIO device models | immutable commit 9b63ea5f62f1493b5d2bb1c0da54f090d5e25ebe |
| Cuttlefish | Complete virtual Android reference | android-latest-release; Vendor is not universal |
| minigbm / libdrm / gfxstream | Virtual graphics source | android-latest-release; source only until end-to-end validation |
| BoringSSL, zstd, lz4, libxml2, protobuf, googletest | Native dependencies and tests | android-latest-release; preserve license metadata |

The manifest is intentionally selective and does not clone all of AOSP. New projects require a concrete dependency. Each successful sync exports SOURCE_LOCK.xml and SOURCE_LOCK.json; review and commit these when accepting a new baseline.

Do not bulk-copy upstream code into ZeroVM-owned modules. Keep upstream repositories in their own checkouts, preserve license files and carry local changes as auditable patches. Repository-level license metadata is not a substitute for file-level and transitive license review.
